summary: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory filed a Form 424B5 prospectus as part of an already-effective shelf registration statement (No. 333-296978) allowing for the sale of up to $6,000,000 in common stock, preferred stock, debt securities, warrants, or units from time to time. The filing provides a generic securities description with no specific offering details, terms, or pricing. It is a routine shelf takedown prospectus filed pursuant to Rule 424(b)(5), updating disclosures for potential future at-the-market or underwritten offerings. No specific deal, merger, tender, or special-situation event is triggered. The filing is a regulatory step, not a special-situation classification event.
